name: 33981 · Pt Charlotte, FL
findings: ZIP 33981 (Pt Charlotte) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33981 (Pt Charlotte) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
